scenarios.expected: cancelling the confirmation issues no delete request at all
scenarios.testId: INSTANCE-01 cancel does not issue a delete request

scenarios.expected: exactly one deleteInstance call and the instance disappears from the re-rendered list
scenarios.testId: INSTANCE-02 confirm removes the instance from the list and re-renders

scenarios.expected: no stale selection id survives the removal (falls back to a remaining instance or empty)
scenarios.testId: INSTANCE-03 removing the selected instance clears the stale selection

scenarios.entry: confirm button double click while the request is in flight
scenarios.expected: the button becomes disabled and only one request is issued
scenarios.testId: INSTANCE-04 repeated clicks during the request issue one request

scenarios.expected: the panel shows the failure text AND a retry action; retrying calls listRecoveries again
scenarios.testId: RECOVERY-01 recovery query failure shows an error and a retry action

scenarios.entry: openRecoveryPanel with an empty recoveries list
scenarios.expected: empty state text, no restore button
scenarios.testId: RECOVERY-02 empty recovery list shows the empty state

scenarios.expected: success toast, panel reloaded, no conflict wording
scenarios.testId: RECOVERY-03 normal restore reports success and refreshes the panel

scenarios.entry: openRecoveryPanel rendering of a partial/failed record
scenarios.expected: each file is listed with its own state and error; the panel never claims everything was restored
scenarios.testId: RECOVERY-04 partial results list each file with its state

scenarios.expected: a conflict notice is shown and the UI never says the file was overwritten
scenarios.testId: RECOVERY-05 conflict result never claims a successful overwrite

scenarios.entry: restore button busy state and failure recovery
scenarios.expected: button disabled while in flight; after the rejection it is enabled again and the failure is reported
scenarios.testId: RECOVERY-06 submit disables the button and failure restores it

scenarios.expected: the normal start button is shown and the safety guidance stays visible
scenarios.testId: BISECT-01 no pending session shows the normal start entry

scenarios.entry: openModBisect with bisectPending -> { pending: true, canContinue: true }
scenarios.expected: restore and continue entries are offered; continue is disabled when canContinue is false
scenarios.testId: BISECT-02 pending session offers restore or continue

scenarios.expected: an explicit 'cannot confirm the previous state, retry' state with a retry action; the panel must not silently pretend there is no pending session
scenarios.testId: BISECT-03 pending query failure shows an explicit error and retry

scenarios.expected: the panel stays in the needs-recovery state, lists the files and never shows a finished result
scenarios.testId: BISECT-04 file-lock failure keeps the needs-recovery state

scenarios.entry: drawBisect retry recovery failing with payload.needsRecovery
scenarios.expected: the needs-recovery panel is re-rendered; no all-complete message
scenarios.testId: BISECT-05 failed recovery never shows all-complete

scenarios.expected: a non-empty operationId is bound to the request before any cancel entry is offered
scenarios.testId: IMPORT-01 operationId is bound before cancel is offered

scenarios.entry: cancel before the server accepted the import
scenarios.expected: the user is told the import was cancelled; no failure wording
scenarios.testId: IMPORT-02 cancel before acceptance reports the cancelled result

scenarios.entry: cancel after the server accepted the import
scenarios.expected: the real server result is shown, not an unconditional 'cancelled' claim
scenarios.testId: IMPORT-03 cancel after acceptance reports the real server result

scenarios.expected: the UI reports the cancel failed and never claims the import is cancelled
scenarios.testId: IMPORT-04 unknown or failed cancel never claims the import was cancelled

scenarios.expected: the local report is usable and no AI/provider error is produced
scenarios.testId: DIAGNOSIS-01 local diagnosis works without an API key

scenarios.entry: openDiagnoseHistory with an empty report list
scenarios.expected: empty state text, no export buttons
scenarios.testId: DIAGNOSIS-02 empty history shows the empty state

scenarios.expected: an explicit failure text AND a retry action that re-queries
scenarios.testId: DIAGNOSIS-03 history query failure shows an error and retry

scenarios.entry: openDiagnoseHistory rendering a non-empty history (includeEvidence unchecked)
scenarios.expected: the report renders and the export request carries includeEvidence=false; the UI states that the original evidence is not included
scenarios.testId: DIAGNOSIS-04 a non-empty history renders and export states the evidence scope

scenarios.entry: initUpdateSection with a status that has no lastApplyResult
scenarios.expected: no warning block and no success claim
scenarios.testId: UPDATE-01 no previous apply result shows no false alarm

scenarios.expected: an explicit 'still on the old version' warning with the tried version
scenarios.testId: UPDATE-02 a previous non-applied update is reported as still old

scenarios.expected: defaults are filled in and nothing throws
scenarios.testId: UPDATE-03 missing compatibility fields do not crash

scenarios.expected: no success/completed wording is rendered
scenarios.testId: UPDATE-04 status query failure never shows update success
